component.name: Cook's Notebook
component.summary: Classic dishes step by step, and what you can cook

description.p: Cook's Notebook is a helper in the kitchen. Pick a classic dish by country, set the portions, and the app shows every amount for them and leads you through the method one step at a time, with the time and temperature the source gives and a short note on a technique where it helps.

It also tells you what you can cook from what is at hand: it reads the household's stock and lists the classics that stock allows, and the ones that lack only an ingredient or two. Every classic names its source. There is no language model: the notes are written from textbooks and named sources.

It works offline. The classics are built in; the stock stays on your device unless the household shares a space over storage it configured itself, on GitHub or on a WebDAV server of its choice. There is no server of ours, no account and no telemetry.
Cook's Notebook is now also an app for Linux phones and desktops: browse the classics by country, set the portions, cook step by step and see what you can cook from your stock.
